theorem QOU.QuarkState.WeakVertexLeftProjector.insertion_eq_zero_iff {K : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [Field K] [LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] [Ring A] [Algebra K A] {q : K} {σ : A} (hq : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : q + q⁻¹ ≠ 0) (hs : Helicity.IsLetter q σ) (hL : LeftLine.leftLine q σ ≠ 0) :
LeftLine.weakVertex q σ - σ = 0 ↔ q - q⁻¹ = 0

theorem QOU.QuarkState.WeakVertexLeftProjector.skein_eq_neg_bracket_insertion {K : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [Field K] [LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] [Ring A] [Algebra K A] {q : K} {σ : A} (hq : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : q + q⁻¹ ≠ 0) (hs : Helicity.IsLetter q σ) (h : 1 < |q|) :
q • σ - q⁻¹ • Helicity.flip q σ = -((q + q⁻¹) • (LeftLine.weakVertex q σ - σ))

theorem QOU.QuarkState.WeakVertexLeftProjector.skein_dominant_root {K : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [Field K] [LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] [Ring A] [Algebra K A] {q : K} {σ : A} (hq : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : q + q⁻¹ ≠ 0) {t : K} (ht : t = q ∨ t = -q⁻¹) (h1 : 1 < |t|) :
t • σ - t⁻¹ • Helicity.flip q σ = (t - t⁻¹) • (t + t⁻¹) • LeftLine.leftLine q σ

theorem QOU.QuarkState.WeakVertexLeftProjector.skein_eq_rightLine {K : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [Field K] [LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] [Ring A] [Algebra K A] {q : K} {σ : A} (hq2 : q + q⁻¹ ≠ 0) (h : ¬1 < |q|) :

theorem QOU.QuarkState.WeakVertexLeftProjector.skein_eq_leftLine {K : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [Field K] [LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] [Ring A] [Algebra K A] {q : K} {σ : A} (hq2 : q + q⁻¹ ≠ 0) (h : 1 < |q|) :
q • σ - q⁻¹ • Helicity.flip q σ = (q - q⁻¹) • (q + q⁻¹) • LeftLine.leftLine q σ

theorem QOU.QuarkState.WeakVertexLeftProjector.one_sided_iff_smul_leftLine {K : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [Field K] [LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] [Ring A] [Algebra K A] {q : K} {σ : A} (hq : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : q + q⁻¹ ≠ 0) (hs : Helicity.IsLetter q σ) (a b : K) :
(a • 1 + b • σ) * LeftLine.rightLine q σ = 0 ↔ ∃ (c : K), a • 1 + b • σ = c • LeftLine.leftLine q σ

theorem QOU.QuarkState.WeakVertexLeftProjector.leftLine_idem {K : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [Field K] [LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] [Ring A] [Algebra K A] {q : K} {σ : A} (hq : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : q + q⁻¹ ≠ 0) (hs : Helicity.IsLetter q σ) :

theorem QOU.QuarkState.WeakVertexLeftProjector.insertion_mul_leftLine {K : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [Field K] [LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] [Ring A] [Algebra K A] {q : K} {σ : A} (hq : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : q + q⁻¹ ≠ 0) (hs : Helicity.IsLetter q σ) (hidem : LeftLine.leftLine q σ * LeftLine.leftLine q σ = LeftLine.leftLine q σ) :

theorem QOU.QuarkState.WeakVertexLeftProjector.insertion_mul_rightLine {K : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [Field K] [LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] [Ring A] [Algebra K A] {q : K} {σ : A} (hq : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : q + q⁻¹ ≠ 0) (hs : Helicity.IsLetter q σ) :

theorem QOU.QuarkState.WeakVertexLeftProjector.weakVertex_sub_letter {K : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [Field K] [LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] [Ring A] [Algebra K A] {q : K} {σ : A} (hq : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : q + q⁻¹ ≠ 0) (hs : Helicity.IsLetter q σ) :

theorem QOU.QuarkState.WeakVertexLeftProjector.weakVertex_eq_split {K : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [Field K] [LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] [Ring A] [Algebra K A] {q : K} {σ : A} (hq : q ≠ 0) (hq2 : q + q⁻¹ ≠ 0) (hs : Helicity.IsLetter q σ) :

theorem QOU.QuarkState.WeakVertexLeftProjector.flip_sub_self {K : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [Field K] [Ring A] [Algebra K A] (q : K) (σ : A) :

theorem QOU.QuarkState.WeakVertexLeftProjector.leftLine_mul_rightLine {K : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [Field K] [LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] [Ring A] [Algebra K A] {q : K} {σ : A} (hq : q ≠ 0) (hs : Helicity.IsLetter q σ) :

theorem QOU.QuarkState.WeakVertexLeftProjector.split_lines {K : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [Field K] [LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] [Ring A] [Algebra K A] {q : K} {σ : A} (hq2 : q + q⁻¹ ≠ 0) (x : A) :
